articles.title: Pods as Workers, Not Agents: Rethinking the Deployment Unit for AI Agents on Kubernetes
articles.reason: This article presents a practical approach to optimizing AI agent deployment on Kubernetes, directly relevant for building scalable, cost-effective agentic workflows in enterprise environments.

This deployment pattern is highly relevant for consultants architecting multi-agent pipelines on cloud infrastructure.
actionable_insights: Evaluate current agent deployment patterns for inefficiencies in Pod-per-agent models.
